taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-30 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 74.2 | 15.31 | 15.31
2 | 27.3 | 18.79 | 34.10
3 | 76.3 | 5.06 | 39.16
4 | 96.3 | 4.07 | 43.23
5 | 138.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-30
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: 15.31 - 34.10 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of approximately 45 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity, saturated weathered aquifer (Layer 2) and anchor into the competent basement. Install well screens and gravel packing across the 15.3 to 34.1 m interval for optimal groundwater yield.
